risks.risk: Machine may not print, copy or scan, or may show error codes
risks.proof: Clip of the machine making a colour copy from the feeder and the printed page held to the camera

risks.risk: Very high page count, worn drum units, fuser or transfer belt
risks.proof: Photo of the total counter page on the control panel screen

risks.risk: Missing or empty toner, drum or imaging units inside
risks.proof: Photo with front doors open showing all toner cartridges and drum units in place

risks.risk: Colour banding or streaks from worn colour units
risks.proof: Photo of a colour test page printed from the machine

proof_requests: Clip of a colour copy being made and the printed page shown to camera
Photo of the counter screen showing total page count
Photo with front doors open showing toner and drum units
Photo of any error messages on the control panel after power-on
response.reason: Brand and model are readable on the front panel in photo 0, so it can be priced as a non-working Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e until a working copy clip and counter are shown.
